ios.desc:
Darwish AI helps you get better answers by routing your prompt to the right AI model for the job.

Whether you’re writing, studying, planning, translating, or brainstorming, Darwish makes it simple to: 

• Ask once and get a great answer
• Compare responses across models when you want confidence
• Save time with clear, structured results
• Keep everything in one place

Use Darwish for: 

• Writing: emails, captions, essays, resumes
• Study: explanations, summaries, flashcards
• Work: meeting notes, proposals, ideas
• Life: planning, recommendations, checklists
• Arabic + English: bilingual prompts and responses

Built for speed, clarity, and control, so you spend less time prompt-engineering and more time getting things done.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://chat.withdarius.com/privacy
